_comment: Preset judge panels, used the FIRST time the app starts with an empty roster.
After that, the admin console is the source of truth — edit panels there, not here.
Each panel's `code` is what its judges type at /login. Keep them easy to read
aloud: no 0/O or 1/I. Change these before your event; they are public in this repo.
`booking` sets the bookable time slots every panel starts with. startTime is a
24-hour clock time on the day the panels are created; set exact dates later in
Admin > Panels if you need to. Set slotCount to 0 for a walk-up queue only.
A panel can override any of these with its own slotMinutes / slotCount / startTime.
